publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Low-level wind shear is a type of catastrophic weather that can cause aircraft to flip over, stall or even crash. Therefore, it is very important to detect and recognize this phenomenon. In recent years, coherent Lidar has been proposed to detect low-level wind shear, but the common recognition methods need large computation to inverse the wind field to recognize the type. In this paper, compressive sensing (CS) is put forward to quickly sample and reconstruct wind field data, which can greatly reduce the time required for wind field recognition. The wind field data involved in this paper are obtained by simulation. The results of data reconstruction prove that the method mentioned in this paper can describe the whole information with less samples and shorten the follow-up processing time to a certain extent, and improve the real-time recognition of low-level wind shear.

articleTitle: A Novel Protection Scheme for DC Distribution Network with Multi-terminal PV
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: For the sake of meeting the fast isolation of faulted areas for DC distribution network with multi-terminal PV, a novel DC protection scheme is proposed. This scheme is on the basis of the DC current differential coefficient under fault transients, which are the characteristics of the DC current. This property is banded with different settings of value to realize the protection of the DC distribution network with multi-terminal PV. The proposed scheme can realize isolation of faulted areas without communication to satisfy the speed. This scheme, which is simulated on the looped DC distribution network with multi-terminal PV, can detect network faults. The theoretical analysis and simulation results verify that the proposed protection has the effectiveness and superiority.

articleTitle: Spatial Distributions of Radiation Fields in Air from an Underwater Magnetic Dipole Source
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: We apply the parallel TSS-FDTD method to obtain the spatial distributions of fields in air radiated from an underwater magnetic dipole source. The equivalent principle is used to calculate the far fields in a far zone by recording the tangential electromagnetic fields on a virtual surface above the air-sea surface. Numerical results show that the presence of sea surface affects the spatial distributions of electric field along the propagation direction.

articleTitle: Characteristic Modes Analysis of Orbital Angular Momentum Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Characteristic Mode Theory is proposed as a systematic method for antenna design, and it provides an easy way to understand the physics behind the radiation of microstrip patch antennas. It has been shown that characteristic modes are orthogonal. In this paper, elliptical patch antennas, with easy fabrication and a single-feed circular polarization, which can generate OAM of 1=2 at 2.4 GHz, is first analyzed using CM theory. The coaxial probe feed position is then appropriately selected to excite the desired CMs with respect to their modal currents. The modal significance and characteristic currents of the elliptical patch are analyzed to describe and explain the performances of the structure. Simultaneously, OAM antennas along with analysis results are given, which clearly demonstrate the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: A Low-Profile, Gain-Enhancement, Compact Lens for UHF Archimedean Spiral Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A compact lens for UHF Archimedean spiral antenna is presented in this paper. The focusing lens, which size is $0.4\lambda _{0}$*$0.4\lambda _{0}$*$0.006\lambda _{0}$, can find significant gain enhancement by 4. 87dB at 300MHz without affecting the return loss of the antenna, located in the distance of 60mm($0.06\lambda _{0}$) ahead of the antenna. Once the optimum dimensions of the lens is obtained, it is possible to change the number of grooves and permittivity of the material to increase the gain of the UHF antenna at other frequencies.

articleTitle: Micro-Doppler Feature Extraction Method of Rotating Target Based on Shipborne Radar
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A novel delayed conjugated multiplication and sparse decomposition method is proposed to extract the micromotion feature of rotating target with shipborne radar. Combined with the motion mode of shipborne platform, the echo signal of rotating target is analyzed. The influence of ship-swaying is eliminated by delayed conjugated multiplication processing. A set of micro-Doppler (m-D) basis-signals are constructed. Thus after sparse decomposition processing, the m-D features of every scatter are successively extracted according to the coefficients. Finally, the effectiveness of the approach is validated by simulations.

articleTitle: Random Radiation Metamaterial Aperture design for Coincidence Imaging
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The test modes (uncorrelated complex radiation petterns), which are generated by the metamaterial aperture, have been widely used in the coincidence imaging system. However, the design of the metamaterial aperture and the requirement of the coincidence imaging are still disconnected theoretically. In this paper, we attempt to present the problems in the connection of the metamaterial aperture design and the coincidence imaging requirement. Firstly, the property of the metamaterial cells depends on the structure, which is hard to be modeled in the aperture design. Then, the physical constraints, which should be considered in the requirement of the coincidence imaging, are hard to be given. Finally, the number of the test modes that contained in the aperture is hard to evaluate in theory. We believe the presented problems can be solved in the next few years.

articleTitle: Cascaded Scheme for Sport Event Classification based on Object Level Motion Trajectory
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a sport training events classification is proposed by a cascaded scheme based on object level motion trajectory. Firstly, a new dataset was introduced that separates and marks the ball-stopping events of sport training videos from 133 players cover 5 different schools. Secondly, object detection neural network is used to localize soccer and players in a video and a new method is proposed to separate the different ball-stopping events. Thirdly, a cascaded scheme is proposed by concatenating an object detection network with a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network. The LSTM network is employed to classify discrete ball-stopping events based on the bounding boxes detected by the object detection network. Experiments tested on more than 1800 ball-stopping events show that the proposed method can achieve an average accuracy of 93.12%.

articleTitle: Thermal Analysis and Optimization of High-Power Planar Schottky Diodes with Different Substrates
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, thermal analysis and optimization of high-power planar Schottky diodes with different substrates are presented. In order to accurately predict the thermal profile of multiplier chip with multi-anode planar Schottky diodes, the temperature-dependent properties of both dissipated power of diode and thermal conductivity of substrate are taken into consideration in the modeling. The impacts of the spacing between two adjacent anodes and geometrical size of substrate, on junction temperature are investigated in detail. The simulation results are helpful to guide the design and optimization of planar Schottky diodes.

articleTitle: A Secure Received Signal Strength based Indoor Localization Algorithm Using OS-ELM and Clustering Analysis Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a secure machine learning based indoor localization algorithm is proposed, when the received signal strength (RSS) measurement fingerprint based training data set is given by chunk-by-chunk and contains the attacked training data samples. In the off-line phase, the hierarchical clustering approach is proposed to distinguish the attacked training data and the attacked-free training data, firstly. By the above data pre-processing, the attacked RSS measurements is found and can be deleted. Then, the online sequential extreme learning machine (OS-ELM) algorithm is used to training the attacked-free data in turn. In on-line phase, according to the obtained RSS measurements, the obtained regression models are straightly used for final position estimation. Field tests are carried out to show the advantage of the proposed secure localization algorithm over traditional OS-ELM based approach.

articleTitle: Wireless Signal Service Type Identification Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Nowadays, with the birth of 5G and the Internet of Things, more and more business signals have emerged. The identification of signal service types has become a hot research topic. Whether it is suitable for daily life in the military field, there is a wide application prospect. Using the power spectrum data of the wireless signal, the characteristics of the power spectrum waveform are captured to identify the type of traffic of the wireless signal. This paper proposes the use of convolutional neural networks to extract and classify the wireless signal power spectrum data. After hundreds of iterative training, it can achieve an ideal recognition effect.

articleTitle: Stochastic Stability of Networked Markovian Switching Systems via Asynchronous Controller
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: We consider that there exist delays and random packet dropouts (PDs) in the communication network. Based on this background, this paper focuses on the stochastic stability for networked Markovian switching systems (NMSS). The modes of NMSS and desired controller do not need to synchronize, and they are determined by two mutually independent Markov chains, respectively. A sufficient condition is derived such that the closed-loop NMSS can be stochastically stable. A numerical example and simulations show the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: FPGA Based Short-Range Targets Detection System with FMCW Radar
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that there exists distance blind area for traditional pulsed radar so as to it cannot realize the detection of targets within short range. A solution based on the frequency-modulated continuous wave system is proposed to meet the demand of short-range targets detection. By adopting the zero intermediate frequency receiving scheme, using the transceiver split antennas, and with the frequency modulation continuous wave, the blind area ranging from Om to 150m is effectively achieved. In this paper, the principle of short-range targets detection is given and the signal processing process of FMCW radar implemented by FPGA with limited resources is emphatically introduced. The results of simulation and field test verify the feasibility of our system solution.

articleTitle: A Novel Frequency Selective Surface Radome with Circular Polarization Selection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A new frequency selective surface(FSS) radome with circular polarization (CP) selection is presented in this paper. This radome operates the Ka-band by passing waves in 23 GHz – 30 GHz and reflects the waves outside. At the same time, within 24.25 GHz – 27 GHz, the proposed structure provides axial ratio (AR) lower than 3 dB with transmission coefficients better than 1.5 dB for left -hand circular polarization (LHCP) wave, whereas for right-hand circular polarization (RHCP) wave, it provides transmission coefficients lower than –10 dB.

articleTitle: The Simulation Analysis of Airborne Antenna Siting Based on the Measured Pattern
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The measured pattern in free space can be equivalent to a Spherical Wave Expansion (SWE) model which is used for analyzing the airborne antenna siting in the absence of antenna CAD model. Physical Optics (PO) is selected for addressing electrically large size problem. The application example shows that the antenna pattern test and electromagnetic numerical simulation are used for the siting analysis of radio altimeter antenna on the amphibious aircraft.

articleTitle: Coupling Tunable D-band Directional Coupler for Millimeter-wave Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The directional coupler is an important device for the millimeter-wave applications such as the electron cyclotron system in the magnetic confinement fusion research. A coupling tunable D-band directional coupler was designed based on a novel coupling grid structure proposed in this paper. The designed directional coupler has excellent performance with ultra-wideband. The coupling can be tuned from -28.2 dB to -33.2 dB at 140 GHz by changing the angle of the coupling grid, and the dynamic range of the coupling is about 5 dB. The return loss is smaller than -15 dB in the whole D-band from 110 GHz to 170 GHz. A 3-dB coupler using the similar coupling structure was also designed. The coupling is 3.3144 dB at the center frequency of 140 GHz.

articleTitle: Joint Angle And Array Gain-phase Error Estimation For Bistatic MIMO Radar With Unknown Colored Noise
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, the estimation of joint angle and array gain-phase error in multiple-input multiple-output (MI-MO) radar with unknown colored noise is investigated, and the tensor-based joint angle and array gain-phase error estimation is proposed. In the proposed method, the temporal uncorrelated property of unknown colored noise is utilized to construct a third-order tensor to remove the effect of unknown colored noise. Then parallel factor (PARAFAC) decomposition is utilized to achieve transmit direction matrix estimation and receive direction matrix estimation. The gain-phase error is estimated through Lagrange multipliers. After that, the angle estimation can be achieved through the estimation of gain-phase error. The proposed approach not only eliminates the influence of gain-phase error, but also removes the impact of unknown colored noise. Therefore, our method achieves superior estimation performance. Numerical examples demonstrate the superiority of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method for Integrated Energy System Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Considering the demand response of the integrated energy system, an evaluation method for integrated energy system is proposed. With respect to the influencing factors of environmental protection, economy, reliability and energy consumption, an evaluation indicator system is established. The weights of the indicators are calculated by using the analytic network process (ANP) method and the system is graded. Finally, an example is given to compare the evaluation values considering the demand response with the actual values.

articleTitle: A Fast Circular Convolution Imaging Algorithm for FMCW CSAR
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The frequency modulated continuous wave circular synthetic aperture radar (FMCW CSAR) is a high resolution imaging radar, which has always played an important role in target recognition. However, the wave number domain imaging algorithm based on FMCW CSAR has a low efficiency. Therefore, a fast circular convolution algorithm is proposed in this paper. With the method, the convolution is applied to express the scattering and the Fourier transform is used to calculate the convolution, which can avoid the complex calculation of the system kernel function and improve the imaging efficiency when the target is located in the center of the scene. Some simulation results illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: MPPSK Demodulation Based on Neural Network under Impulsive Noise
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Artificial neural network (ANN) has been widely used in many different fields including wireless communications, and shows superior properties. A novel demodulation scheme based on ANN for M-ary position phase shift keying (MPPSK) is proposed in this paper, which can be used to demodulate strictly band limited MPPSK signal with impulsive noise. Although high-order MPPSK signal can increase spectral efficiency in long-waveform channel, the main lobe of the signal is limited by the antenna, which causes inter-symbol-interference (ISI) and energy loss. Therefore, the symbol error rate (SER) cannot meet the requirement of the system. This paper proposes a novel scheme based on ANN to solve interference caused by the antenna and impulsive noise. The simulations demonstrate that this scheme can improve demodulation performance significantly for low frequency MPPSK signal, compared with a common demodulation scheme.

articleTitle: A Wideband Feeding Network for Compact Circularly Polarized Patch Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a wideband feeding network is proposed to match low-profile circularly polarized patch antennas (including the bandwidth of GPS and Beidou navigation system). By loading some metal posts, resonance frequency caused by the eigenmode is shifted to out of the occupied bandwidth. The feeding network consists of three Wilkinson power dividers. Every adjacent output port of the proposed feeding network has about 90° phase shifter in the occupied bandwidth, and the insertion loss of every port is about 0.5 dB. The gap between two substrates of feeding network should be well controlled in order to ensure the performance of the feeding network. Simulation and experiment results show that the relative bandwidth of the circularly polarized antenna loading this feeding network is about 37% for VSWR <2 and AR <3 dB from 1.164 to 1.64GHz.

articleTitle: A Novel Mobile Agent Based Energy Efficient Data Gather Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In wireless sensor networks (WSNs), complicated network topology has become a promising research in terms of routing protocols. Clustering technology is an efficient approach to balancing battery consumption of sensor devices in the entire sensing field. In this paper, we adopt an uneven clustering method to slow down the dead rate of sensor nodes especially in vicinity of base station. During the phase of data transmission, we insert a mobile agent (MA) that takes charge of data gather in network model, which can alleviate the overload problem of cluster heads (CHs). Moreover, we take single hop and multiple hops hybrid mechanism to forward packets and design an optimal migratory route for mobile agent, our proposed algorithm mainly combines greedy selection strategy and Hamilton loop algorithm, and the experimental consequences show that our scheme is superior to other algorithms in energy dissipation and packet delivery latency.

articleTitle: Real-time Route Re-planning based on Modified Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, the problem of three-dimensional real-time route replanning for Unmanned Aerial Vehicl(UAV) is formally defined, and the route penalty degree is used to evaluate the route. A modified particle swarm optimization algorithm (M-PSO) is proposed to solve the real-time route replanning problem. The Simulation results show that the modified particle swarm optimization algorithm has better real-time and stability in solving the 3D real-time route replanning problem. It can quickly search for routes that can avoid all threat and make the individuals in the population reach convergence state.

articleTitle: Broadband Coding Metasurface with Cross-Polarization Conversion
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a chessboard-like ultra-thin coding metasurface for wave front control from 9.20GHz to 10.75GHz. The metasurface is formed by four different Micro unit cells, and the arrangement of the Micro unit cells is like a chessboard. The phase difference between every two adjacent Micro unitcells is 180°. These Micro unit cellshave the same structure but rotated 90° in turn. The wave front of the incidence can be controlled according to the unit cells that compose the Micro unit cells arrangement and the monostatic radar cross section (RCS) can be reduced. The thickness of metasurface is 1.27 mm.

articleTitle: ICEICT 2019 TOC
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Presents the table of contents/splash page of the proceedings record.

articleTitle: ICEICT 2019 Organizing Committee
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Provides a listing of current committee members and society officers.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Imaging and Detection Technology Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Magnetic Induction Tomography (MIT) is a process tomography based on the principle of electromagnetic induction. In this paper, a set of 8 coil electromagnetic tomography system with working frequency of 1MHz is designed based on the systematic review of the research status and shortcomings of electromagnetic tomography technology. On the basis of the completion of the system design, the iron balls of different numbers and positions are taken as experimental objects, and the two-dimensional image of the field 40×40 pixels is inversely established by using the back-projection method and the Tikhonov regularization method, and the imaging results are analyzed. Both algorithms can perform better image reconstruction on the detection area faster.

articleTitle: Frequency Hopping Synchronization Method and Simulation in VHF Channel
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Synchronization is one of the key techniques to frequency-hopping (FH) communication. Based on the requests of synchronization for a VHF FH communication system, this paper puts forward a synchronization scheme, which is achieved accurately and rapidly by using a Self synchronization-head method combined correlation code with time of day (TOD), which contains synchronous interval information. This paper mainly studies frame format of FH Synchronization, synchronization of FH pattern, FH tracking, and so on. The performance of synchronization shows that the time of initial synchronization in FH communication system meets the requirements. In addition, simulation under the Gauss White Noise channel and Tactical channel indicates that the system has high capture probability.

articleTitle: Application of Golay Complementary Code in Pipeline Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: We experimentally implement a pair of golay complementary sequences with variable length and frequency. The generated complementary sequences can be applied into pipeline detection. The two-dimensional image of the pipeline is obtained by the correlation method and back projection algorithm. The results show that the pipeline can be located by using this system.

articleTitle: High-Efficiency Broadband Polarization Rotator for W-Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, an ultrathin, broadband and high-efficiency reflection-type polarization rotator is proposed to convert the polarization state of a linear polarized incident wave to its cross-polarized component under a wide incident angle range of 35°. The proposed structure shows a relatively broad bandwidth of 42.2% (68.96-105.52 GHz) with a maximum insertion loss of 0.5 dB, while the co-polarized reflection coefficient keeps less than -10dB. The proposed reflective polarization rotator may find applications in reflector antenna system and reducing the RCS.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Weighted Extreme Learning Machine for Robust Modeling
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Radar performance prediction is becoming more and more important in Product-Life-Cycle-Management of radar. However, modeling the performance is difficult because of the strong nonlinearity from radar’s complex system as well as immeasurable effects like electromagnetic interference, instrument accuracy and so on. This paper proposes a probability weighted extreme learning machine to model the performance of radar under noise. First, a distributed extreme learning machine modeling is developed, upon which the probability distribution function (PDF) of multiple local models is estimated by the Parzen window method. This distribution function is further used as weights to integrate all local models to construct a global robust ELM model. The successful application of this robust probabilistic weighted ELM method to both artificial case and real life case demonstrates its great advantages in the modeling of an unknown system with various kinds of random noise.

articleTitle: Broadband Polarization-Sensitive Reflection Metamaterial Aperture in Terahertz Band
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A broadband polarization-sensitive reflection metamaterial aperture (BPRMA) for coincidence imaging in terahertz band is proposed in this paper. The BPRMA consists of broadband polarization-sensitive metamaterial elements with different rotation directions. Firstly, the metamaterial element with cross-polarization conversion characteristic in terahertz band is designed and the broadband characteristic is achieved by sweeping the parameter W of the metamaterial element. Then, the BPRMA is designed via randomly distributing metamaterial elements with different rotation directions and different parameter Ws. The cross-polarization characteristic can be used to generate various measurement modes (i.e., the reflection patterns of the BPRMA) by altering the polarization angle of the incident plane wave. Finally, the reflection coefficients of the metamaterial element are presented, and the correlation coefficients of the reflection patterns generated from different polarized incident waves as well as from different frequencies are also studied. The design is validated through simulation results.

articleTitle: Optimum Design and Software Implementation for RS(255,223) Decoder
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: RS codes which are widely used in various kinds of data communication and storage systems with its good burst error and random error correction ability. With the background of CCSDS standards to meet the RS (255, 223) code, elaborating the basic principle of RS decoding. This paper designed the RS (255, 223) decoder using Visual C++ under the Windows operating system environment and carried out a simulation. The results show that burst errors and random errors which the errors code does not exceed the maximum error correction capacity can be corrected. This improves the reliability of the communication system.

articleTitle: A Two-step Impedance Measurement Method using One Port Technique with VNA
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: new two-step method is proposed to accurately analyze time-domain impedance based on VNA frequency-domain data in this paper. The method is based on one port reflection scatter parameter to construct time-domain response of the DUT. The method proposed in this paper is mainly composed of two steps. In the first step, we calibrate the instrument at the test port, and then use the traceable standard impedance air line for time domain setting calibration; the second step is to obtain the impedance characteristics of the device under test based on above setting. Finally, a practical measurement example of stepped impedance air line is given to verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Application of Variogram in Quantitative Characterization of Channel Sand Body Spatial Distribution
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper introduces the basic concept, theoretical model and parameter meaning of experimental variogram, which is a basic tool of geostatistics. From the two aspects of singular value and influence of mixed distribution, the influencing factors of reservoir geological characteristics in the process of experimental variogram calculation and the corresponding solutions, as well as the fitting method of experimental variogram and theoretical model are analyzed. By fitting the spherical variogram of the channel sand body in a dense well pattern, it is shown that the variogram can be used for quantitative analysis and prediction of the spatial distribution characteristics of channel sand body, which provides a basis for future sand body description and sedimentary microfacies research.

articleTitle: Research on Health Big Data Preprocessing Technology Based on AHSMM and Bacterial Foraging Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: With the development of big data technology and the popularity of Internet of Things technology, the demand for management is becoming more and more serious. In order to solve the problem of health big data preprocessing technology, the method of Adaptive Hidden Semi-Markov Model (AHSMM) based on bacterial foraging algorithm is proposed. First of all, the bacterial foraging algorithm referring health big data is used to apply the equipment health diagnosis and prediction methods to the actual case of the United States Caterpillar company’s standard health prediction experiments. Next, the proposed method is applied to the actual case of hydraulic pump of Caterpillar company. The results verify the effectiveness and stability of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A Hybrid EMD-Based Signal Denosing Method for Gyrowheel System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Gyrowheel is a multi-function system, providing two-axis rate sensing and three-axis actuation for small spacecrafts. To ensure measurement accuracy, calibration experiments are required, which are affected by the noises in the output signals of the gyrowheel. The unique characteristics of the gyrowheel noises are considered. Thus, a hybrid signal denoising strategy is presented based on the combination of the empirical mode decomposition method and the traditional filter. The denoising results for the measured signals show the effectiveness of the hybrid denoising strategy for removing both high-frequency periodic noises and random noises.

articleTitle: Hybrid Metamaterial Absorber based on the Combination of Plasmonic Structure and Magentic Absorber
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Inspired by efficient spoof surface plasmonic polarization (SSPP), the dispersion characteristic has recently been demonstrated to be flexibly controlled in plasmonic structure. Inspired by this, a comprehensive scheme of hybrid metamaterial absorber (MA) based on the combination of plasmonic absorbing structure (PAS) and magnetic absorber has been proposed which can achieve extremely broadband absorption with the efficiency over 90% during the frequency band from 4.2GHz to 40.0GHz. The proposed concept provides an effective scheme with the simultaneous capability of broadband absorption, polarization insensitivity as well as lightweight characteristic, promising an extensive range of applications in electromagnetic compatibility/shielding.

articleTitle: Robust Power Management for Cooperation in Jammed Wireless Localization Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a robust power management method is proposed to solve the power allocation problem in a jammed cooperative wireless localization system. Because the localization accuracy and the lifetime of networks are both depended on the power allocation strategies, it is a critical task to trade-off the localization accuracy and power consumption through power management method. Moreover, if there are jammer nodes, the problem meets new challenge to consider the effect of jammers. So in this paper, we develop a power management method to minimize the localization errors with power constraints. First, the cooperation between agent nodes is considered in a jammed wireless localization system. Then the uncertain parameters of different nodes are derived to obtain robust power allocation strategies. What’s more, the problem can be transformed into semi-definite programs (SDPs) to have efficient solutions. Simulation results indicate that the proposed power management method can reach more efficient power allocation strategies than uniform power allocation and the robust strategies have better performance than non-robust strategies.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional Interferometric Imaging of Space Rotating Targets in Low-resolution Radar based on Multiple Measurement Vectors Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) imaging of space targets is capable of realizing targets feature extraction, classification and recognition. In this paper, a 3D interferometric imaging method via multiple measurement vector (MMV) model is proposed for space rotating targets in low-resolution radar. Unlike the existing methods separating the micro-Doppler (m-D) curves of scatterers from the images, the micro-motion parameters can be extracted directly from the echo, which are the important components of m-D curves. Then, by obtaining the interferometric phases on the curves, the coordinates of the scatterers can be calculated. Finally, the 3D imaging of targets is reconstructed. Simulation results show that this method can effectively realize the 3D imaging of the rotating space targets even though the radar pulse repetition frequency (PRF) is insufficient. In addition, compared with the single measurement vector model (SMV), the MMV-based method performs better in robustness.

articleTitle: Statistical approximation properties of Stancu type λ-Bernstein operators
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a Stancu type λ Bernstein operators, and obtain the moments and the limitation of central moments of these operators, study a statistical approximation theorem and a Voronovskaja type theorem by using the concept of statistical convergence. We also give an example to show the convergent effect of these operators to certain function f.

articleTitle: Improved Island Microgrid Fault Analysis by Considering the Effect of DG Control Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: During system faulty condition, the output of inverter-type distributed generation is different from the traditional generation but according to the different distributed generation (DG) control methods. In this paper, a new fault analyzing method which considers the negative effect of DG control methods is proposed. Firstly, an equivalent fault analysis model of inverter type DG is developed by considering the constraints of different control methods, in terms of active and reactive power (PQ) control and V/F control. Based on the equivalent model, the fault analysis of island microgrid under the scenarios of PQ and V/F control is carried out by establishing equivalent island microgrid model. The fault voltage and current are calculated by solving the constrain equations based on different DG controls. Besides, both symmetrical and asymmetrical fault conditions are analyzed. Finally, the well-developed power grid simulation software DIgSILENT is applied to build a typical micro-grid model containing inverter-type DGs which is functioned with PQ control and V/F control. The results of the proposed analysis method are compared with the well-developed simulation results and typical conventional analyzing method. The comparison results verify that the proposed fault analysis method is effective and has great accuracy on the computation of fault data.

articleTitle: The Effect of Ship-borne X-band Radar Vertical Motion on Significant Wave Height Estimation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The significant wave height (SWH) is one of the most important ocean wave information describing sea state. The high-precision SWH can be extracted using the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) method based on shore-based X-band radar. However, for ship-borne case, the error of the extracted SWH increases because of the motion of ship-borne radar. In this paper, the effect of ship-borne X-band radar vertical motion on SWH estimation is analyzed in detail. First, radar images of ocean wave are simulated based on linear wave theory. Then, the relationships between the illumination rate and the detection distance at different antenna heights are discussed. Finally, the effect of the vertical motion amplitude of the ship-born radar on the root square of SNR is investigated. Simulation results show that the vertical motion of the ship-borne radar is one of the main reasons for the increasement of SWH estimation error. Furthermore, the root square of SNR and the change rate of the vertical motion amplitude are negatively correlated. This work provides a significant theoretical foundation in future application for ocean remote sensing using ship-borne X-band radar.

articleTitle: Multiple Measurement Vector Sparsity Adaptive Algorithm Realize the non-orthogonal Waveform Separation of MIMO Sparse Linear Array
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to solve the irregular crossing distance migration (IRCM) in the compression sensing waveform separation method, the paper studies the characteristics of the signal received by MIMO radar and explores the joint sparsity of the multiple measurement vector in different observation channels. Multiple measurement vector sparse recovery algorithm is used to separate the echo replaced the single-observation vector restoration algorithm. It cannot only reconstruct the one-dimensional distance image with high precision but also suppress the IRCM. Aiming at the problem that current joint sparse recovery algorithm has poor separation effect due to the unknown sparsity, a sparse degree adaptive joint sparse recovery algorithm is proposed to improve the effect of waveform separation.

articleTitle: Multi-MWC Cooperative Spectrum Sensing Algorithm based on Clustering
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The sampling method of modulated wideband converter (MWC) can perform compressed sampling far below the Nyquist rate for sparse multiband analog signal, and can be accurately reconstructed. To solve the problems of multi-path, shadow and hidden terminals in single-node wideband spectrum sensing, a Multi-MWC cooperative spectrum sensing algorithm based on clustering is proposed. Based on SOMP reconstruction algorithm, a DMWC joint reconstruction algorithm is designed. This algorithm utilizes the correlation between the signals perceived by the nodes in the cluster to realize the joint signal detection of multi-MWC compression sampling model. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm improves the reconstruction performance at low SNR, improves the accuracy of spectrum sensing, and reduces the hardware complexity of single node MWC compression sampling channel.

articleTitle: The Study on the Encryption Technology of Black Core Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: High Assurance Internet Protocol Encryptor is one of the key technology which is used to construct Global Information Grid by the black core network. It is also the basic facility to ensure the end-to-end transmission security of IP network. The composition and principle of High Assurance Internet Protocol Encryptor are proposed. Moreover, the deployment pattern and the functionality are introduced. In special, the comparison of network security and performance is carried out through the analysis of the encryptor deployment in the typical black core network architecture. All in all, the above results can be used to the design of tactical wireless network, where the network security and performance should be considered at the same time.

articleTitle: Research on a Method for Effectively Improving the Bandwidth of Dipole Antennas
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to improve the bandwidth of the dipole antenna, a parallel fence-shaped dipole is proposed. The traveling wave component perpendicular to the direction of the dipole arm is increased by the coupling of current between the fence-shaped arms, thereby reducing the reflection occurring on the dipole. Through the CST Microwave Studio® modeling and simulation, when the structural dimensions are similar, the relative bandwidth of the proposed parallel fence-shaped dipole is increased to 2.4 times that of the common shaped planar dipole, and its radiation performance is comparable to common shaped planar dipole.

articleTitle: Interleaved Matched Filtering Method Suitable for ASIC Design
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The research of LEO satellite communication system is crucial for the development of modern wireless communication. However, it is significant to realize the design and implementation of the baseband signal processor. In order to adapt to the ASIC design of the multi-mode baseband digital signal processor and optimize the structure of digital receiver, this paper proposes an interleaved digital matched filtering (IDMF) method suitable for ASIC design and bring in the IDMF module which can reduce the consumption of logical resources and power. According to the result of simulation and implementation of FPGA, it is verified that the IDMF method is able to reduce the consumption of logical resources by approximately 15%. Particularly, the multiplier resources decrease close to 1/10 of that in the traditional method.

articleTitle: The Simulation Testing Design of Amphibious Formation Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to improve the reliability of the demand analysis for amphibious formation, it is necessary to construct the simulation testing environment of verification, validation and accreditation. The component-based developing mode, the parameterization modeling method and the simulation engines of operational behavior, communication network opening and communication controlling are used in the design framework. Also, a typical case is simulated in the designed simulation testing environment, and the research of amphibious communication equipments could be guided by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Uplink Power Compensation of Rain Attenuation on Satellite Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In satellite communication, the signal fading may be maximized due to the rain attenuation in the rainy weather. In order to overcome the signal fading, an uplink power compensation method is proposed in this work. Through detection of satellite signal strength, the rain attenuation in satellite communication link can be eliminated, and the ground station power will be adjusted to achieve the maximum compensation according to the rain attenuation values, which effectively reduce the influence of rain attenuation on the communication quality compared to the traditional methods.

articleTitle: Calibration of Indoor EM Location System based on Polynomial Fitting
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Electromagnetic positioning system is a system that can obtain the position and direction angle of the receiving sensor in real time by using the spatial magnetic field strength. It has been widely used in virtual reality and medical navigation applications. Due to its inherent characteristics, the accuracy and stability of electromagnetic positioning system receiving sensor is sensible to external interference, which leads to a large positioning error in its positioning and tracking data. So the calibration methods are very necessary, in which polynomial fitting is often used to reduce the electromagnetic positioning error. Traditional polynomial fitting may usually bring some errors but in this paper a improved polynomial fitting is proposed which segments and fits those error according to the trend of sampling point. Simulations show that the segmentation fit calibration is better than the traditional polynomial fit.

articleTitle: A Research on Design of Campus Printing Service System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In the career of an undergraduate, printing documents is essential whether it is in research or development. However, the current printing services are defective. In response to these problems, we decide to research how to improve the efficiency of campus printing services. This paper elaborates on the design and development of the printing system from the aspects of development framework, database design and system function module design.

articleTitle: Wideband Tunable Bandstop Frequency Selective Surface Based on Liquid Crystal
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a tunable bandstop frequency selective surface (FSS) is designed based on liquid crystal (LC). The FSS is a sandwich structure, which contains two antisymmetric metallic layers, separated by LC. The relative permittivity of LC can be controlled between 2.5 and 3.3 by changing bias voltage. The simulation results show that continuous tunable feature of the FSS is obtained, from 17.938 GHz to 20.152 GHz, of which the tunable range is 11.63%.

articleTitle: Ku Band Dual-Polarized Microstrip Array Antenna with Wide-Band and Low Side-Lobe
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A $4 \times8$ dual-polarized microstrip antenna array in the need of synthetic aperture radar (SAR)’s engineering requirement is proposed in this thesis. The design of antenna element structure is based on the common aperture-coupled antennas. To improve the impedance bandwidth, some metalized via holes are introduced surrounded the feeding lines. To improve the isolation and reduce the cross polarization, two-layered power divider networks are optimized and antiphase technique is introduced. Furthermore, array weighting is used to control the side-lobe level of the antenna. The simulated results indicate that an impedance bandwidth of 1.5 GHz with VSWR less than 1.5 can be realized. The isolation between the two ports is better than 42 dB, and the cross-polarization levels are over 50 dB in both E and H planes. By using the Chebyshev current distribution, the side-lobe level in azimuth direction is lower than -20 dB.

articleTitle: Source Recovery of Underdetermined Blind Source Separation Based on Modified Shortest Path Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Shortest path algorithm is a simple algorithm used for source recovery of underdetermined blind source separation (UBSS), but this algorithm is only applicable to the case where the number of sensors is two. However, in most real-life scenarios, the number of sensors is more than two. Then we proposed a smoothing method to improve the shortest path algorithm. The main thought is as follows: assume the number of sensors is<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sup>, select two adjacent observed signals to form a combination each time, then m — 1 kinds of combination are generated. As to each combination, recover their source signals by using the traditional shortest path algorithm, and m —1 groups of recovered source signals are derived, and then average the sum of all the corresponding signal values of m —1 groups. To verify the modified shortest path algorithm, simulations are performed when source signals are sufficiently sparse and insufficiently sparse respectively, and results show that the modified algorithm proposed in this paper is applicable when the number of sensors is two or more. The modified method enriches the tools that can be utilized for underdetermined source signal recovery.

articleTitle: Method of waveguide port excitation producing appointed direction wave in FEM calculation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The calculational formulations of exciting appointed direction wave for finite element method are presented. Based on two dimensional finite element method, modes fields of electrical field and magnetic field are achieved firstly. Equivalent source of electric and magnetic current sources are presented simultaneously, which ensure the sole direction of wave that one wants. The calculating results validate the correctness of formulation and method.

articleTitle: Design of Parallel Multi-Module’s Current Sharing Control Method for New DC Output Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The application of high power switching power supply has become more and more important. Single power module is difficult to meet the requirements of production work. In this paper, DC output is realized directly by Permanent Magnetic Synchronous Generator with several three-phase rectifier modules in parallel. Current-sharing technology is the core of uniform current distribution in parallel modules. Because the current sharing control in the simulated mode has a wide range of bandwidth, and there are large number of discrete components in analog circuits, the circuits are susceptible to external environment and increase the instability factors. In this paper, a digital current sharing control method based on CAN bus is proposed. If one of the power supply modules fails, there is no effect on the other modules of the whole parallel system, and the status of each power module is equal. Moreover, the digital current sharing control technology has the advantages of less discrete devices, easy to maintain and upgrade. At the same time, the simulation model is built by Saber, and the rectifier arm of each power supply module is analyzed by Fluent. The results of circuit and thermal analysis show that the current-sharing control method is effective.

articleTitle: Dual-band Bandstop Filter Based-on Graphene in the Infrared Frequency Range
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A graphene-based dual-band bandstop filter (DB-BSF) is presented in the infrared band. The filter is made up with a graphene waveguide and two graphene-ribbon resonators on the Al2O3/Si substrate, which supports waveguide mode and edge mode, respectively. The center frequency of each stopband can be independently adjusted by applying different bias electric fields upon graphene ribbons. The proposed configuration is significant in novel optical communication systems as a critical component.

articleTitle: ISAR High Resolution Imaging Based on Fast Sparse Bayesian Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of poor ISAR imaging quality and long computation time with sparse apertures, a high resolution imaging algorithm based on fast sparse Bayesian learning is proposed. Firstly, an imaging model with sparse apertures based on compressed sensing is established. Then, it is assumed that each pixel of the target image obeys Gaussian prior to establish a sparse Bayesian model, and the fast marginal likelihood maximization method is used to reconstruct the high quality target image. Compared with the traditional sparse Bayesian learning method, the fast algorithm proposed can shorten the computation time while ensuring the quality of reconstruction. Finally, simulation experiments verify the effectiveness and superiority of the algorithm.

articleTitle: A Design of Compact Wideband Bandpass Filter with Controllable Center Frequency Using Different Rectangular Arrays
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This study presents a design of compact wideband bandpass filter with a chip size of $1140 \mu m \times 1424 \mu m$ (including pads) and fabricated through GaAs-based integrated passive technology. The proposed bandpass filter is consisted of an intertwined spiral inductor and a rectangular-array-capacitor. The spiral inductor is intertwined targeting to achieve a high inductance so that the center frequency of bandpass filter could be lower, moreover, a compact size can be obtained. As for the capacitor, through changing the size and number of rectangular array, the capacitance can be varied and thusly, the center frequency of bandpass filter can be controlled. Simulation results show that a wide bandwidth with fractional bandwidth of 126%, and the center frequency could be varied from 3.35 GHz to 3.19 GHz through changing the size and number rectangular array. Furthermore, the frequency of lower band transmission zero could be varied from 2.40 GHz to 2.35 GHz, the frequency of upper band transmission zero could be varied from 7.21 GHz to 7.13 GHz, giving an option to slightly enhance the selectivity of bandpass filter. This study is expected to give a method for the design of controllable bandpass filter based on semiconductor fabrication technology.

articleTitle: The Asymmetric Transmission Depending on the Propagation Direction Using Spoof Surface Plasmon Polaritons
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this letter, we propose a new structure possessing asymmetric transmission. For a linearly polarized wave illuminates on the structure in two opposite directions, the device behaves transparently or like an absorber. Such one-way propagation characteristic results from polarization conversion and polarization selective absorption performance of the structure. Simulation results indicate that the structure achieves a linearly polarized EM wave with asymmetric transmission. The work provides an effective method to design an asymmetric transmission structure.

articleTitle: Recursive Kernel MPE Loss Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Kernel mean p-power error (KMPE) as a robust learning loss has been successfully employed to design robust PCA and ELM. This paper proposes a novel recursive adaptive filtering algorithm via the KMPE loss to identify linear system parameters under non-Gaussian noise cases. To derive the recursive KMPE algorithm, a KMPE loss with a forgetting factor is given first, and then the gradient method is employed to derive a recursive form of the weight estimation with a gain matrix for the system. Numerical simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm with a suitable p value can obtain higher steady-state accuracy and faster convergence rate compared with some other existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Wireless Information and Power Transfer Protocol with Three Nodes in Wireless Body Area Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In recent years, Wireless Body Area Networks (WBANs) have become a hot research topic. The energy of each sensor node in WBAN is limited, but we would like to extend the life cycle of the sensor node. Therefore, in this work, we introduce energy harvesting technology to achieve sustainable operation of sensor nodes. In this paper, a Simultaneous Wireless Information and Power Transmission (SWIPT) model among three sensor nodes is proposed. A reasonable energy and information transmission algorithm is presented to minimize the outage probability, and the resources are allocated reasonably. Finally, numerical simulations demonstrate the reliability of the proposed algorithm to minimize the outage probability with energy harvesting. In addition, this paper analyzes the factors that can influence outage probabilities, such as energy harvesting rate, number of time slots, and confirms that both factors are negatively correlated with outage probability.

Author Keywords: simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT)

articleTitle: Design of Receiver Performance Online Monitoring System in Radar BIT
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In view of the limited ability of conventional BIT monitoring, the performance of radar receivers cannot be monitored without obvious symptoms of failure. To solve the problem, a receiver performance monitoring system in radar BIT is designed. The system consists of embedded computer, virtual instrument module and receiver performance parameter monitoring module, which can complete on-line monitoring of receiver sensitivity, noise coefficient, improvement factor, amplitude and phase consistency and other performance indicators. The system has been applied in a radar receiver performance monitoring system, which effectively solves the problem that the radar BIT state monitoring capability is limited, and the effect is good.

articleTitle: Extended Random Fourier Features Recursive Non-quadratic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The extended recursive non-quadratic (EX-RNQ) algorithm can improve the filtering performance of the extended recursive least-squares (EX-RLS) algorithm in the state-space model. To improve the filtering performance of EX-RNQ, a novel extended random Fourier features recursive non-quadratic (EX-RFFRNQ) algorithm is proposed by transforming the input data into a high-dimensional feature space with the random Fourier features (RFF) method under the non-quadratic error criterion. In comparison with the kernel adaptive filters (KAFs), the proposed EX-RFFRNQ algorithm can achieve the performance improvement in a fixed-dimensional network structure and thus require no sparsification. Monte Carlo simulations on channel tracking and short-term chaotic time-series prediction validate the superiority of the proposed EX-RFFRNQ algorithm.

articleTitle: Compact Bandpass Filter With Good Selectivity And Wide Stopband Using Embedded SIRs
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: compact bandpass filter (BPF) with four transmission zeros (TZs) is developed using folded half-wavelength stepped impedance resonators (SIR). A feed structure is designed and analyzed firstly. Then, by embedding three half-wavelength SIRs, a BPF with good selectivity and four TZs in stopband is realized. Moreover, the filter becomes more compact by folding the SIRs. Therefore, the filter has compact size, good selectivity and stopband performance. The simulation result verifies the feasibility of the design.

articleTitle: Multi-scale Principle Manifold Learning Noise Reduction Method for Telemetry Vibration Signal
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Telemetry vibration signal contains a great deal of information that reflects the status of the aircraft during the test, and has characteristics of strong noise, non-linear, non-stationary, transient impact and so on. How to effectively denoise the signal without changing the dynamic characteristics of the system directly related to the accuracy of flight state analysis. To solve this problem, a phase space multi-scale principle manifold learning noise reduction method based on double tree complex wavelets was proposed. Firstly, the noisy signal was orthogonally decomposed into each scale band by the double-tree complex wavelet transform. Then according to the spatial distribution of signal and noise in each scale band, the wavelet coefficients in each scale were respectively identified by the phase space principle manifold learning algorithm, which could remove noise by projecting the scale coefficients from the high dimensional phase space to the intrinsic dimensional space projection. Finally, the denoised wavelet coefficients were reconstructed to obtain the vibration signal. Simulation and experimental results showed the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Transient Response Analysis of Monopole Antenna Mounted on Conductive Plane Varying Different Positions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: High-altitude electromagnetic pulse (HEMP) leads a serious threaten to the communication systems with working in the frequency range of VHF or HF. For analyzing the effect of the positions of monopole antenna mounted on a conductive plane to its transient response, the combination of a typical electromagnetic computing method- method of Moment and Fourier transform is used to obtain the transient response. The procedure validation is proved with commercial electromagnetic software and radiation test. With two field distribution configurations of HEMP incident wave, this paper provides the analysis and comparison of transient response for the SC current and load current of monopole antenna port when monopole is mounted on different positions of a conductive plane. The results are meaningful to the antenna placement in practical application scenarios when considering HEMP environment.

articleTitle: A Hierarchical Control Strategy for Electric Vehicle Coordinated Charging
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The increase of Plug-in Electric Vehicle (PEV) load brought big impact on the power system, which threaten safety and reliability operation of distribute network. Therefore, a coordination PEV charging scheme is urgently needed in the grid dispatching system to make PEVs the smooth access to the grid at all levels, and decrease the difference between load peak and off-peak. The proposed two-level charging strategy is mainly based on sub-control centers at charging station level and main control centers at municipal level. The PEVs charging load guiding curves can be obtained at the main control centers by solving load-shifting optimization problem, which is allocated to sub-control centers to follow. In this way, control centers can achieve load-shifting and reduce charging cost according to actual situation. Simulations verify the effectiveness of proposed hierarchical control framework.

articleTitle: Wideband Tunable Bandstop Frequency Selective Surface Based on Liquid Crystal
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a tunable bandstop frequency selective surface (FSS) is designed based on liquid crystal (LC). The FSS is a sandwich structure, which contains two antisymmetric metallic layers, separated by LC. The relative permittivity of LC can be controlled between 2.5 and 3.3 by changing bias voltage. The simulation results show that continuous tunable feature of the FSS is obtained, from 17.938 GHz to 20.152 GHz, of which the tunable range is 11.63%.

articleTitle: ICI Suppression of Underwater Acoustic OFDM Signal Transmission by Differential Multichannel Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an underwater communication method that can realize real-time communication, which can be used for communication between high-speed UUV and underwater intelligent nodes. This method of Doppler compensation of orthogonal frequency division multiplexed signals for underwater communication does not utilize the conventional channel estimation method, but uses the concept of decomposing channel variations based on a set of known functions. OFDM symbol reconstruction is performed after the T (Taylor)-FFT decomposition channel. A stochastic gradient adaptive algorithm is designed to learn the combination of detection weights. Thus, the two steps of channel matching filtering and channel balancing are implemented by one step. The validity and correctness of this method are verified by the recent experimental data (several kilometers in shallow water, 12-15 kHz band) of mobile underwater acoustic communication provide technical support for high-speed mobile object communication.

articleTitle: Low Sidelobe Holographically Modulated Reactance Surface Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A low sidelobe holographically modulated reactance surface antenna is proposed in this paper. The low sidelobe can be achieved through properly controlling of the antenna aperture distribution. By slightly changing of the patch on unit cell of holographic antenna, the cosine distribution of antenna aperture field and the low sidelobe is realized. And the effect on sidelobe level with different modulation factor is also compared. The designed antenna works at 10 GHz with radiation angle of 30 deg, and the simulated gain reaches 17.1 dBi with sidelobe level of l0.4dB.

articleTitle: Application Research of Spatial Integrated Data Mining Technology on Land Intelligent Grading
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This article proposed an integrated decision tree classification and combination weighting algorithm to achieve intelligent grading and planning of urban residential land. The algorithm process could find the spatial correlation of land classification in the same town, and analyze the quality of land use among different towns. Taking the grading of residential land in Changchun as an example, this article used GIS spatial analysis to obtain spatial attribute data with grading factors of Changchun City, and combined with the integrated data mining technology to calculate the different land areas’ action scores, and finally obtained the empirical research results in order to provide appropriate reference for land use and planning management in Changchun City.

articleTitle: Phase Synchronization Method for Millimeter Wave Radiometer Digital Correlator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: L-band geostationary orbit millimeter-wave radiometer for meteorological disaster warning, using synthetic aperture technology and FPGA-based digital correlator to replace traditional analog correlators, has great advantages in integration, variable integration time, number of channels, etc. There are 70 antenna channels in the system, requiring a maximum integration time of 200ms. A multi-channel phase synchronization method based on phase compensation is proposed in this paper. This scheme has high flexibility and can be adapted to different front-end antenna elements. The test result shows that the phase difference between 70 channels reaches the critical index requirement of less than 100ps and has good inversion imaging effect.

articleTitle: Multimode Wideband MIMO Antenna with Dual-polarized Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A multimode wideband MIMO antenna with dual-polarized characteristic is presented in this paper. The wideband performance can be obtained by exciting multiple modes, including loop mode, slot mode, monopole mode, high order mode, etc. Due to the fact that two elements share the same radiation aperture, the proposed antenna can obtain a compact size of 56×48 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Furthermore, the two feed ports are designed orthogonally to realize dual-polarized characteristic and high port isolation. A prototype is fabricated and tested. The planar antenna structure makes the proposed antenna low cost and easy to be manufactured. The measured results demonstrate that both the two elements can cover a - 10dB impedance bandwidth of 1.91GHz-4.98GHz. And the port isolation is more than 15dB within the operating frequency band.

articleTitle: Weighted heterogeneous networks with the same weight sequence
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Generally, the topological property has a profound influence on various dynamical process occurring on networks. However, whether the topological property can characterize the dynamic process of networks separately or jointly is still unknown. The problem needs to be verified based on some special networks with the same topological property. Aiming at the requirement, a class of weighted heterogeneous networks with the same weight sequence are proposed. We solve the main structural characteristics of our networks. We hope that the networks presented in this paper could help us study the influence of weight distribution on network dynamics.

articleTitle: Design Of MIMO Radar Orthogonal Polyphase Code Based On Improved Artificial Bee Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A new method based on artificial bee colony algorithm (ABC) is presented to optimize the cost function in design of multiple input multiple output (MIMO) radar orthogonal polyphase code, which could reach lower autocorrelation peak sidelobe (ASP) and cross-correlation peak (CP). The proposed algorithm combined ABC algorithm and taboo search algorithm (TS), so it could improve the local search ability of ABC algorithm and enhance its search efficiency because of smaller search space. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can generate the solutions that have higher mainlobe-to-sidelobe ratio. In the meantime, the improved algorithm is scalable and easy to implement.

articleTitle: Analysis of Time-Domain Shielding Performance of Enclosure With Apertures Based on Analytic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The uncertainty of the simulation results is large due to the modeling error and numerical dispersion, when using the existing numerical simulation method to obtain the time-domain waveform of enclosure with apertures. In this paper, an approximate solution of the shielding effectiveness curve of any position in an enclosure with apertures was obtained by the analytic algorithm. The time-domain waveform of the enclosure with apertures was further analyzed by using the minimum phase method, and the validity of the modified method was verified by comparison with the CST simulation results. Compared with the current method of artificial intelligence for predicting shielding effectiveness, the method has a solid physical foundation and is fast and convenient. It has reference significance for system protection design, test and so on.

articleTitle: A Transmittive/Absorptive Frequency Selective Surface by Cascading Multi-layer Square Loops
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a transmittive/absorptive Frequency selective surface (FSS) is proposed. The integrated FSS consists of two layers of resistors loaded in double square loops and one layer of band-stop arrays. The top two layers and the bottom band-stop arrays are separated by a foam layer. The proposed FSS allows the lower frequency wave to transmit while the higher frequency wave is absorbed. In lower frequency band, the insertion loss is far below -3dB. In higher frequency band, the absorption is higher than 90%, under normal incidence. In addition, the proposed FSS exhibits great resonant stability and good absorption rate. The incidence angle of transverse electric (TE) and transverse magnetic (TM) polarization is 0° (normal incidence) to 40°. In addition, the prototype of FSS has been measured and produced. The measured results are in good agreement with the simulation results.

articleTitle: Excitation of Trapped Modes in a Lattice of Dielectric Particles
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: An all-dielectric metasurface featuring resonant condition of the trapped mode excitation is considered. It is composed of a lattice of subwavelength particles made of high-refractive-index dielectric materials. These particles are structured in the form of disk having a round eccentric penetrating hole. Each particle in the lattice behaves as an individual all-dielectric resonator supporting a set of electric and magnetic modes. Since a particular asymmetry is introduced into the particles forming the lattice with respect to the electric field vector of the normally incident radiating wave, in addition to common electric and magnetic Mie-type resonances, the trapped mode with a high quality factor is excited. We involve the method of multipole expansion to reveal all peculiarities of the trapped mode excitation. Eventually, we observe and verify the excitation of the trapped mode in the microwave experiment.

articleTitle: Secrecy and Efficiency in Overlay Cognitive Full-duplex Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a new collaboration-based transmission scheme for overlay cognitive full-duplex wireless wiretap networks, where a full-duplex transmitter can help the primary system transmit information and utilizes the licensed spectrum to transmit its own information. In order to analyze the performance of the proposed scheme, we derive the exact secrecy outage probability expression of primary information transmission and the effective throughput of secondary information transmission. From the simulation results, we can conclude that the proposed scheme can effectively improve the secrecy performance of primary transmission and throughput of secondary transmission without any other additional power.

articleTitle: A New Roust Blind Beamformer Against Array Errors Under Intensive Interferences
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: It is known that the performance of standard Capon beamformer (SCB) can be degraded tremendously when there exists an unknown mismatch between the presumed signal steering vector and the practical one.
